title: Deep Learning - Part 1
description: Deep learning covering neural networks, CNN, RNN, LSTM, transfer learning, model training, and evaluation with TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch. This submodule covers: Neural networks, Perceptron, Activation functions, Forward propagation.
learning_outcomes: Understand neural network fundamentals and architectures
Implement convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for image tasks
Work with recurrent neural networks (RNNs) and LSTMs for sequences
